credits.title: The Mongoose
credits.overview: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

credits.title: The Open Door
credits.overview: A pirate radio station is granting callers their hearts' desires. But as some teenagers find out, be careful what you wish for.

credits.title: Hot Parts
credits.overview: A stripper infiltrates a ring of car thieves to avenge her murdered brother.
